notes.title: Chapter 1
notes.content:
A narrative-rich, action-adventure RPG, Founding of Valtoria takes players to the turbulent early days of Valtoria’s creation. As war, betrayal, and ancient evils threaten the land, players must battle, strategize, and forge alliances to ensure the city’s survival.

Game Features:

[b]Dynamic Combat System[/b] – Utilize light and heavy attacks, parries, and a rage meter in fast-paced battles against human and monstrous foes.

[b]Immersive Storytelling[/b] – Experience a gripping 5-7 hour campaign with dialogue choices that shape character relationships and the fate of Valtoria.

[b]Strategic Decision-Making[/b] – Influence the city’s governance through diplomacy, resource management, and military tactics.

[b]Semi-Open World Exploration[/b] – Traverse diverse landscapes, from the war-torn Silver Fields to the haunted Dark Forest and the besieged town of Hearthstead.

[b]Dynamic Weather and Visual Storytelling[/b] – Encounter changing conditions that impact battles, exploration, and immersion.

[b]Major Battles & Sieges [/b]– Engage in large-scale combat scenarios such as the Battle at the Silver Fields and the Siege of Hearthstead.

[b]Replayability[/b] – Multiple dialogue paths and decision-based outcomes encourage different playthroughs.


As Valenor, Eldric, Mara, and others rise to power, players must determine whether Valtoria will be a beacon of hope or succumb to darkness. Your choices define its legacy.

notes.title: New Character creation beginnings
notes.content: We are refining our character creation system to allow players, aged 20 or above, the option to include a spouse when creating their character. Additionally, this addition enables players to customize the appearance of their chosen spouse.
